entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Starving Dire Wolf
entries.text:
A Starving Dire Wolf burst from cover at the Frozen Pine Hollow and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the Starving Dire Wolf.

log: You use Greatsword: d20 [19] (normal) + 3 Strength + 2 proficiency = 24 vs AC 13. Hit.
Turn order: Starving Dire Wolf → You.
Starving Dire Wolf: d20 [10] (normal) +4 = 14 vs your AC 16. Miss.
A Starving Dire Wolf burst from cover at the Frozen Pine Hollow and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Starving Dire Wolf
story.premise: A combat test: a Starving Dire Wolf ambushes Kara Vell at the Frozen Pine Hollow while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: A Starving Dire Wolf burst from cover at the Frozen Pine Hollow and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the Starving Dire Wolf.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.
story.secret: There is no hidden twist; this is a straightforward combat test encounter.
story.foeAppearance: A huge grey-black wolf, ribs showing through matted fur, yellow eyes and a torn left ear. Its muzzle is scarred and its hackles stand high.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Frozen Pine Hollow
bridge.description: A snow-dusted hollow ringed by dark pines, with fresh tracks circling a fallen log.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a braided copper beard ring, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.
